{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows with missing values in either flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g
complete_data = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Compute Pearson correlation
correlation = complete_data['flipper_length_mm'].corr(complete_data['body_mass_g'])

# Print the result
correlation"}
